caption: The drawing depicts a dustpan with a long, straight handle extending backward from a rectangular metal pan. The pan is colored in shades of brown and dark gray, with distinct highlights and shading to indicate its metallic surface. The front edge of the pan is straight and slightly raised, while the sides curve upward and the back is tall with a jagged, irregular edge, suggesting wear or damage. There are two metal legs or supports attached at the front corners, angling down to provide stability. The dustpan is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects present. The artist's signature, "Alois E. Ulrich," is located in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Ember Carrier
